Resolves #19651
Related: #19515

When the keyboard-scroll regression fails, it now attaches DOM selection and subsequent worker-backed selection, row VDOM/vnode, scroll, and update state as `grid-selection-state` JSON. Reads have a three-second deadline; diagnostic errors preserve partial evidence and the original failure. The existing test body is byte-identical. This is a diagnostic capability; the intermittent producer remains unresolved.

Evidence: L3 (real-browser collector controls and clean regression) → L3 required for all three diagnostic ACs. No remaining leaf AC. Root-cause reproduction and repair remain owned by #19515.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | Outside-CI stale-DOM control: DOM selected `[r3c12, r3c3]`; model `[neo-record-9__c3]`; row VDOM and vnode each selected only `r3c3`; no diagnostic error. |
| AC-2 | Outside-CI stalled-worker control: DOM retained, worker absent, named three-second diagnostic timeout; the original c3-vs-c12 assertion was the sole test error. |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/grid/KeyboardNavigationScroll.spec.mjs`. Outside-CI final clean run passed with only the ordinary trace attachment; mechanical comparison confirms the original test body is unchanged. Engine-only selection retained. |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. The deadline bounds waiting, not cancellation of an already-dispatched read. DOM and worker timestamps delimit sequential observations, not an atomic snapshot.

## Test Evidence

Node 24.19, branded headless Chrome, fresh isolated webpack server per run, `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` and `NEO_E2E_PORT` unset:

```sh
NEO_E2E_RUN_ID=<run-id> npm run test-e2e -- test/playwright/e2e/grid/KeyboardNavigationScroll.spec.mjs --workers=1
```

- `sophie-19515-diagnostic-stale-control`: after confirming c3, temporarily added the selected class/ARIA flag to pooled slot 0 (c12). The original final assertion failed and the attachment distinguished DOM from worker projections.
- `sophie-19515-diagnostic-worker-timeout`: same control plus a never-resolving `Neo.worker.App.getConfigs`. The assertion still failed normally; partial JSON recorded the deadline.
- `sophie-19515-diagnostic-final`: both controls removed; 1/1 passed, no diagnostic attachment. These controls validate the collector, not reproduction of the original intermittent bug.

Control traces are retained under `test/playwright/test-results/e2e/battery/<run-id>/artifacts/`; the JSON attachment is also embedded in the Playwright report. No temporary mutation ships.

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here (npm reports Missing script). Shared baseline jobs must supply that check; the author's change-class declaration is `capability`.

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** mechanical. A test-only, failure-only diagnostic inside one existing spec. No engine code, and no change to the test body or its assertions.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The claim: a failing keyboard-scroll run now attaches DOM-first selection state, then worker-backed selection, row VDom and vnode, bounded by a three-second deadline, without touching passing runs or the original failure. I verified it at exact head `7979e0a7b0` against `dev` sources:
- **`Neo.worker.App.getConfigs`** is a registered remote taking `{id, keys}`. It returns an array, or `false` when the instance is missing, and the collector maps that to `missingInstance`.
- **`Row` cells** carry `html`, `data.{field, recordId}` and `aria-selected`, which the VDom mapping reads.
- **`View.selectedCells`** returns the selection model's items.

**What I looked for:**
- **The original failure stays the error.** Every collector fault lands in `diagnosticError` or a `console.warn`, so the `afterEach` cannot throw.
- **Passing runs pay nothing.** The status check gates all collection, and the arrow sequence and its timing are untouched (the test body is not in the diff).
- **No unhandled rejection at teardown.** `Promise.race` keeps its handler on the losing read, so a late rejection while the page closes cannot surface as an unhandled rejection.
- **Engine-only selection is kept.** The spec's imports and fixture are unchanged.

**Scope:** the diff touches no site the ticket did not name.

**Findings:** None.
